title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Given a string of brackets, decide if every open bracket is closed in the correct order.
description:
Given a string of brackets, decide if every open bracket is closed in the correct order.

Approach: Scan left→right. Push opens. On a close, pop and match. Empty stack at end ⇒ valid.
